regions.today: Sunny spells and scattered showers this evening with moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Showers will die out early tonight and it will become mainly dry with some clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 4 to 7 degrees with light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: After a dry start, outbreaks of showery rain will spread from the west tomorrow morning. The showers will turn heavy and persistent at times, with a risk of hail and thunderstorms. Highs of 12 or 13 degrees with moderate southwest winds, gusty in and around showers.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Saturday and moderate on Sunday.
